name: ENDPOINTS_ONLY_PRE
change: Use 1998 and 2000 as pre; keep 2003-2004 post
classification_rule: Compare point-estimate side of 1 with primary

name: LATEST_CLEAN_PRE
change: Use 2000 only as pre; keep 2003-2004 post
purpose: Check dependence on older baseline years
classification_rule: Compare point-estimate side of 1 with primary

name: ADVERSARIAL_LOWER_IRR
change: Treated pre missing=primary; treated post missing=non-primary; control pre missing=non-primary; control post missing=primary
classification_rule: Together with MISS_HIGH forms missingness direction bound

name: ADVERSARIAL_UPPER_IRR
change: Treated pre missing=non-primary; treated post missing=primary; control pre missing=primary; control post missing=non-primary

name: LEAVE_ONE_TREATED_EVENT_OUT
change: Refit primary model five times, dropping one treated event
classification_rule: If any point estimate flips side of 1 => TREATED_EVENT_SENSITIVE

name: LEAVE_ONE_CONTROL_EVENT_OUT
change: Refit primary model twenty times, dropping one control event
classification_rule: Report min/max IRR and any sign flip

name: LEGAL_FORM_DESCRIPTIVE
change: Estimate common-board and federation treated subsets separately against full controls
classification_rule: Descriptive only; no subgroup significance claims
